about: The collecta of the formulary “Pentecost Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who on this day didst teach the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Ghost, grant us in the same Spirit to relish what is right and ever to rejoice in His consolation. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the same Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
